_doc: Turns / death-momentum variant (README.md 'Turns variant'): during follow the players' lane height oscillates 700 cm (6 s period, centre raised so the lowest point stays move.weave_z_floor 500 cm above the path) and its side offset 1500 cm (9 s period), so the Burrowers climb, dive and turn left/right; every Burrower's J0..J4, mesh transform and anim path-follow / death values are recorded on server and client (Saved/Burrower/pie_headpath_pie_turns.json); at the end of follow (18 s) Aura.Burrower.KillAll runs while they fly at speed; no cut / damage phases (e_tiles, g_damage report OFF). The kill phase lasts timeline.ragdoll_s 5.5 s so check n sees every corpse for landing_after_s 4 s after its death on both machines (a client sees the death up to ~0.3 s later; i_respawn still starts before SpawnInterval 8 s). Checks a..d, f, h, i as usual plus j_climb_dive, k_yaw_turn, l_death_momentum, m_stable, n_death_landing (corpses that start over intact hex tiles come to rest on them), o_no_attach_warning.
